messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: data provenance and scripts to simulate data in example-models
parts:
Whenever you check in data (or review someone else checking
in data), we want to make sure:

* if it's from an external source, an attribution and any scripts
used to munge the data into Stan format,

* if it's fake data, the script used to generate it is included.

Rayleigh, would you mind adding this for these:

https://github.com/stan-dev/example-models/pull/53

Or is there some blanket attribution of this data somewhere?

Thanks,

- Bob


> On Mar 7, 2016, at 12:56 PM, rayleigh <notifi...@github.com> wrote:

>
> It can be tested by sourcing the file, putting the sourced objects into a list, and running RStan on the data list and aforementioned Stan file.

Best,
